#
中国风光摄影，24mm 广角镜头，{清晨|正午|黄昏|蓝调时刻}，地点是{安徽黄山|桂林漓江|湖南张家界|杭州西湖|四川稻城亚丁|新疆喀纳斯|云南元阳梯田}。{春季，{晴朗|薄雾|细雨蒙蒙}，山花初开，新绿点点|夏季，{晴空万里|雷雨将至|雨后云雾升腾}，草木葱茏|秋季，{秋高气爽|晨雾弥漫|多云}，层林尽染，红黄交错|冬季，{大雪纷飞|雪后初晴|寒雾低垂}，皑皑白雪覆盖山川与屋顶}。前景是{一块布满苔藓的岩石|一条蜿蜒的石阶小径|一丛芦苇|一座古老的石拱桥}，中景是{平静如镜的湖面|白墙黛瓦的古村落|蜿蜒的河流|层层叠叠的梯田}，背景是{层峦叠嶂的远山|云海之上的山峰|天边渐变的晚霞}。自然光，真实色彩，细节清晰，画面纵深感强。
#
中国人像摄影，85mm 人像镜头，浅景深。一位{二十岁出头|三十岁左右|四十多岁|六十多岁}的{男性|女性}，{身材匀称|身材修长|体格健壮|身材微胖}，{鹅蛋脸|方脸|瓜子脸|圆脸}，{黑色短发|及肩黑发|扎起的长发马尾|花白的短发}，身穿{素色棉麻衬衫|深色羊毛大衣|改良旗袍式上衣|休闲牛仔夹克}，手里{拿着一把油纸伞|捧着一杯热茶|拿着一本旧书|什么也没拿，双手自然下垂}，背景是{老城区的青砖墙|竹林小径|茶馆窗边|城市街头的霓虹灯}。柔和的侧光，皮肤质感真实，眼神自然。
#
Landscape photograph of China, 24mm wide-angle lens, {early morning|midday|sunset|blue hour}, at {Huangshan in Anhui|the Li River in Guilin|Zhangjiajie in Hunan|West Lake in Hangzhou|Daocheng Yading in Sichuan|Kanas in Xinjiang|the Yuanyang rice terraces in Yunnan}. {Spring, {clear sky|light mist|drizzle}, first blossoms and fresh green leaves|Summer, {clear blue sky|a thunderstorm approaching|clouds rising after rain}, lush vegetation|Autumn, {crisp clear air|morning fog|scattered clouds}, red and golden foliage|Winter, {heavy snowfall|clear sky after snowfall|low cold fog}, white snow covering the mountains and rooftops}. In the foreground {a moss-covered rock|a winding stone stairway|a cluster of reeds|an old stone arch bridge}, in the midground {a mirror-calm lake|a village of white walls and dark tiles|a winding river|layered rice terraces}, in the background {receding mountain ridges|peaks above a sea of clouds|a gradient sunset sky}. Natural light, true-to-life colour, crisp detail, strong sense of depth.
#
Chinese portrait photograph, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field. A {man|woman} aged {early twenties|around thirty|mid forties|mid sixties}, {balanced build|slender build|athletic build|slightly stocky build}, {oval face|square face|heart-shaped face|round face}, {short black hair|shoulder-length black hair|long hair tied in a ponytail|short grey hair}, wearing {a plain linen shirt|a dark wool coat|a modern qipao-style top|a casual denim jacket}, {holding an oil-paper umbrella|holding a cup of hot tea|holding an old book|hands resting naturally at the sides}, background of {a grey-brick wall in an old town|a bamboo grove path|a teahouse window|neon-lit city street}. Soft side light, realistic skin texture, natural gaze.
